title: Mine Create
description: A lightweight modpack centered around Create, with Touhou Little Maid and Farmer's Delight as companions.
body:
A lightweight modpack centered around Create, with Touhou Little Maid and Farmer's Delight as companions.

Create: Build automated production lines using shafts, gears, and rotational power. Experience the mechanical aesthetics of kinetic energy.

Farmer's Delight: Cook rustic countryside meals to support your adventures and mechanical operations.

Touhou Little Maid: Tame and raise your own maid companion — she can assist in combat, feed you, and bring a warm presence to your mechanical workshop.

In one sentence: Let machines free your hands, let a maid brighten your days, and enjoy a hearty meal along the way.
